d8_return.label: Calculation / Inference: centreline track R at 20 C (the part inside D8.2 counted, an upper bound), 20 um barrels, microstrip L over In1 (Inference), runs in parallel; the hot-plug model takes D8.2 as ideal ground and leaves this out

bound.note: the worse of the 1 % and drift cases (the drift case in every figure): R12's bound convention (r12_budget.TOL, R12F8-TRI-06)

turn_on.label: Calculation / Inference (C87 0.72-1.265 x, R10 D-R19-10: X7R tolerance, temperature and bias allowances; resistors +/-1.67 %, SLVSFC9C EN thresholds and leakages at their datasheet bounds)
Calculation / Inference (C87 0.72-1.265 x, R10 D-R19-10: X7R tolerance, temperature and bias allowances; resistors +/-1.00 %, SLVSFC9C EN thresholds and leakages at their datasheet bounds)

chatter_rule.bench_rule: J400 chatter, R12 pass rule: total open time < 6.7 ms in every sliding 100 ms window, U9 on for the whole run (R12F12-TRI-30: the largest 0.1 ms step at least 0.10 ms below the worst-corner limit 6.843 ms, the lower of the two load conventions with EN fed from R80.1)
chatter_rule.label: Calculation / Inference (as en_figures; the load allocations and both pack-load conventions)

en.label: Calculation / Inference (C87 X7R bias allowance, leakages at their datasheet bounds; the resistor drift case Inference)
en.voltage_basis: every voltage the EN model takes (by_pack, seven_ms_line_holds_down_to_V, single_10ms_dropout_needs_pack_V, the turn-on pack range) is R80.1's, the EN divider top (R12F12-TRI-30); with no load current it equals J1's

fire.converter_load_basis: R10 GAP-1 constant power at BAT_IN: the converters' input power and R92 at 7.4 V (other_load_w), plus D5's loss 0.45 V x U2's input current from raw_point at that BAT_IN (R12F10-TRI-09; it was 0.45 V x 0.3 A); other_converter_load_W and d5_W at the four-stall point; the converter current (power / J1) is drawn at U9.5 of the BAT_IN network (R12F12-TRI-30) (Calculation / Inference: allocations, efficiency, SS34 VF)
fire.copper_basis: copper_20C_ohm: the five fire nets' series tracks (fire_copper); copper_70C_ohm, the loop's: the four nets other than BAT_IN at 70 C plus the BAT_IN network's J1 -> Q120.3 resistance at 70 C (R12F12-TRI-30; it replaces the BAT_IN track sum)

dummy_fire.label: Calculation / Inference (FET hot factors, pack model, converter loads, copper model; the R134 drift case Inference): the drop bound takes R134 at its current-maximising low end

gate.basis: R119 / R120 100k, R121 10k, C120 1 uF 50 V X5R (C15849), R126 220R / R127 1k / R128 10k / C126 220 nF (values unchanged from R10 / R11); AO3401A / AO3400A datasheet rows (D-R12-10); C120 tolerance and temperature factors as R10 (no bias credit); Q122 drop 0.1 V and the Q120 hot factor, Inference
gate.q120_rds_row: AO3401A RDS(on) <= 60 mOhm at VGS -4.5 V (25 C)
gate.q120_vgs_note: during a fire Q120's drain = J1 - I_fire x Z[Q120][Q120] - I_conv x Z[Q120][U9] (the BAT_IN network at 70 C, R12F12-TRI-30) and its source a further I_fire x 73.5 mOhm lower (Q120 hot, the -4.5 V row x 1.225; R12F2-TRI-08), and Q121's source sits a further I_fire x the ACT_FET_S copper lower (copper at 70 C; R12F5-TRI-03); the enable time and the 12 V corner have no fire or converter current (bus on, before the fire). A shorted match takes |VGS| below the -4.5 V row, where RDS(on) is above the row value used here (Inference; a fault case, not the fire budget)

q124_vgs_min_basis.label: Calculation / Inference (3V3 window, D-R12-139) (PE4 load about 3.54 mA, <= 3.93 mA with drift, within the 4 mA VOH row; the 3V3 PFM band at R12's VIN and resistor drift)
q124_vgs_min_basis.pe4_load_parts: R127 1k to GND, and R126 220R + R128 10k (10.22 kOhm) to GND
q124_vgs_min_basis.source: DS12110 Rev 8 Table 158 p. 247 (VOH VDD - 0.4 V at 4 / 8 mA); 3V3 drift minimum and maximum (r12_windows.json: the SLUSDW3A section 7.8 PFM band, R12F6-TRI-03); R126 220R / R127 1k / R128 10k 1 % + 100 ppm/K over 67 K (the drift case)

pack_load_sensitivity.basis: the pack carries raw_point's whole converter current (U9 RON maximum and the J1 -> U9 / RAW copper at 70 C, U400 / U403 at their own input nodes, D5 = U2's input current) instead of GAP-1's constant power at BAT_IN, solved together with the fire current on the BAT_IN network (R12F12-TRI-30); not used by the figures above (Calculation / Inference: allocations, efficiency, SS34 VF)

shorted_igniter_guard.note: R10 GAP-5 inputs unchanged on R12 (IWDG 960 LSI cycles, R126 / R127 / R128 / C126, R134 part): carried by identity of inputs (Calculation on allocations / Inference)

fire.status: Calculation on R12 CAD copper with R10 GAP-1 pack model; Inference: FET hot factors, pack, harness, match, converter load allocations

holdup.label: Calculation / Inference (constant-power allocations, D5 drop, C84 allowance, 3.8 V end point, PA6's input leakage row in analog mode; the drift case Inference); pa6_trip_range_ms is the range over the divider tolerance of that case

U4.axis_map: D-R12-54: +X_imu -> +x_board, +Y_imu -> -y_board, +Z_imu out of the top face; roll about +y_board reads -gyro_Y; forward thrust reads -a_Y (Calculation; LSM6DSVE frame Inference)

U6.axis_map: D-R12-54: channel 0 (X) -> +x_board, channel 1 (Y) -> +y_board (rocket axis); forward thrust reads +a on channel 1 (Inference: single-channel sheet figure)

pa6_corners.label: Calculation / Inference (DC-solve upper bounds with the copper at 70 C, the fire loop's corner (R12F9-TRI-04), mutual resistance bounded by the smaller point resistance, the VLOGIC copper to R60 included; the branch currents solved self-consistently, D5's current = U2's input current (R12F10-TRI-09); the BAT_IN network with each case's fire current (R12F12-TRI-30); the upper end at D5 0.25 V with its own currents (R12F12-TRI-31); PA6's +/-250 nA input leakage through R60 || R61 in the window (R12F10-TRI-08); U9 RON at the SLVSFC9C maximum; SS34 VF, the load allocations, the 70 C copper temperature, the leakage row in analog mode and the resistor drift case are Inference); the drop is an upper bound, the margins lower bounds

owner_options.adopted: divider_0p1pct with the band_derivation band (owner option (b), round 9 lane B; R12F9-TRI-04)

band_derivation.basis: the 0.1 % drift case: highest top = healthy four-stall VLOGIC minimum x lowest ratio less PA6's leakage offset; lowest bottom = U9 turn-off VLOGIC through D5 (drift EN chain) x highest ratio plus that offset (+/-250 nA x R60 || R61 at +tol, R12F10-TRI-08); the 30 mV band centred in that room, centre rounded to 1 mV (Calculation / Inference as pa6_corners)
band_derivation.margins_basis: margins_V and both_limits_clear: the adopted band (r12_budget.PA6_THRESHOLD); derived_band_margins_V: band_V

owner_options.label: Calculation / Inference (as pa6_corners; the 0.1 % parts' 25 ppm/K drift case Inference); options for the owner; option (b) adopted (round 9 lane B, O-R12-17)

parts_0p1pct.R61: YAGEO RT0402BRD0710KL (C190095, R401's BOM line), 10k 0.1 % 25 ppm/K, Extended, $0.0246 (1-499)

pa6_corners.trip_bottom_basis: nominal_ratio: the x 11 window against the 1 % EN corner (D-R12-21's original comparison); initial / drift: the divider (0.1 %, PA6_TOL) and the EN chain (1 %) both in that resistor case. Negative above_u9_turn_off_through_d5 = the trip bottom lies below the highest VLOGIC at which U9 can turn off (R12F8-TRI-06)

port_supply.label: Calculation on CAD copper (20 C; the drift rows at 70 C, R12F12-TRI-31) and the r12_windows PORT_4V8 window (upper bound on the drop); the 4.5 V module floor, the LR900-F 5.0 V top and the load allocation are Inference; harness drop not included; valid while U400 VIN >= VO / 0.75

port_supply.window_holds_for: U400 VIN >= VO / 0.75 (TI SLVSD90B 7.3; R12F5-TRI-02): every window figure above assumes U400 regulates; u400_input gives its input and headroom at the four-stall point and on a 6.0 V pack
